title: PyMutBench mutant record
description: One native mutant of a tool, one JSON object per line of <bug-id>.jsonl. Every mutant the tool generates for the given files is a record: one with no faithful plain-source form keeps a status that says why, and still counts as an emission.

path.description: The mutated file, relative to the project root, as in the exported inputs (src/pkg/module.py).

native_id.description: The tool's own identity of the mutant, unique within the bug.

operator.description: The tool's name for the mutation operator, when it has one.

status.description: "ok" when mutated holds the complete mutated file; otherwise the reason no faithful source text exists (the mutant still counts as an emission).

mutated.description: The complete text of the mutated file (UTF-8). Required when status is "ok".

line.description: The line the mutant changes, for a mutant without a text (it then counts in the scope it lies in) or one identical to the original.

gate_line.description: For a tool that mutates only lines its coverage run executed: the line whose execution the mutant needs. The oracle drops the mutant when the historical suite never runs that line.
